spec_metadata.evidence_authority: Feedback Loop fills evidence fields after verification; NOT hand-hardcoded
spec_metadata.alignment: Phase 10 Implementation Design Review §4 (three evidence types, no score/ranking/recommendation)

evidence_goal.promotion_path: PROPOSED → BETA/ACTIVE requires evidence accumulation via Feedback Loop
evidence_goal.declaration_note: Evidence is a declaration of WHAT is needed for promotion, NOT a performance guarantee, NOT a pre-filled 'passed' marker.

evidence_types.source: laboratory product records in product catalog documents
evidence_types.collector: Evidence Collector (L2.2 observer paradigm, read-only extraction)

evidence_types.source: product record + external UNSPSC dictionary + declarative matching specification

form.match_basis: str (textual description, NOT a confidence score)

evidence_types.collector: Human executes matching (this phase only declares the specification, I-3)

evidence_types.source: cross-document ground-truth comparison (candidate mapping vs human-annotated correct code)
evidence_types.nature: validation result fact, NOT hand-computed score

forbidden.quality_score: forbidden — match_basis is textual; cross_doc_success_rate is an auto-computed objective statistic, not a manual quality score
forbidden.ranking: forbidden — candidate mappings are not ranked; no 'best candidate' judgment
forbidden.recommendation: forbidden — no 'recommend this code' output; output is candidate mapping + validation result fact
